about: South Korea's freebie surface is split between government AI and startup programmes and domestic cloud providers that advertise credits in Korean. Cloud credits often require payment-method registration, while DashCloud and Dothome offer card-free hosting with mobile-phone or identity verification. Grassroots finds concentrate in large IT forums such as Clien, where retail deal noise is heavy and free digital offers appear as occasional posts.

communities.focus: Korea's largest general IT forum; its 알뜰구매 board carries occasional limited-time free digital licenses, app giveaways, and provider promotions alongside heavy retail discount noise. Direct access worked from a datacenter address when re-checked on 2026-11-14; if a block page appears, read it through a browser or reader. Verify every offer at the provider.
communities.name: 클리앙 알뜰구매

hunting_grounds.how: Read the latest announcements, open any AI, GPU, cloud-voucher, or startup-support item, and verify eligibility and deadlines on the NIPA detail page and the operator's site. The listing is server-rendered; the watch pattern matches its relative /home/2-2/<id> hrefs.
hunting_grounds.name: NIPA business announcements

hunting_grounds.how: Open the pricing page and confirm the Free plan terms: lifetime free, no payment information, 256MB RAM, 1GB persistent storage, 10GB monthly traffic, and one project. Signup requires one-time mobile-phone verification; recheck the current open-beta terms before claiming.
hunting_grounds.name: DashCloud Free plan

hunting_grounds.how: Read the free-hosting page, then check the signup agreement for current limits and identity checks. The free hosting stays free only while an extension application is filed every 6 months; miss the renewal window and the account is blocked, data is held for 14 days, and recovery can carry fees (provider's free-hosting page, checked 2026-11-14). Real-name or identity verification may be requested.
hunting_grounds.name: Dothome free hosting

hunting_grounds.how: Confirm the current new-signup credit amount and validity, then register a payment method to apply. The offer was 100,000 KRW in discount credit valid for three months; credits cannot be used on already-free or marketplace products.
hunting_grounds.name: NAVER Cloud new-signup credit

hunting_grounds.how: Check the new-signup support programme and apply within three months of signup. The offer was 300,000 KRW in credit; payment-method registration and approval are required, so check the FAQ for exceptions before treating it as card-free.
hunting_grounds.name: KakaoCloud new-signup credit

hunting_grounds.how: Read the API pricing page and confirm the free-run allowance for the document-agent product you need. Each agent included 10 free runs with no credit card required when checked; usage beyond that is metered.
hunting_grounds.name: Upstage document-agent API free runs

hunting_grounds.how: Read the open-announcement listing and open items through the site's go_view action; detail links are JavaScript calls rather than hrefs, so this ground has no watch block. Verify eligibility, deadline, and application path on K-Startup and the programme operator's page.
hunting_grounds.name: K-Startup open business announcements

local_patterns: Cloud credits are the main domestic freebie shape: NAVER Cloud and KakaoCloud both advertised new-signup credits when checked on 2026-11-14, and both required payment-method registration.
Card-free hosting exists but is identity-gated: DashCloud requires one-time mobile-phone verification for its lifetime Free plan, and Dothome may request real-name or identity verification at signup.

Government support is application-based and Korean-language: NIPA and K-Startup publish AI, GPU, cloud-voucher, and startup programmes with eligibility rules that can require a Korean business or resident status.
K-Startup detail links use javascript:go_view(...), so its listing is readable but not watchable; NIPA's /home/2-2 listing uses relative hrefs and is the pack's machine watch.

Clien's 알뜰구매 board is the most accessible large IT forum for free digital offers, but retail discounts dominate. Direct access worked when re-checked on 2026-11-14; a browser or reader is the fallback if a block page appears.
Search Naver first for Korean offers: Google and Bing returned stale or unrelated results during research, while Naver surfaced current provider and community pages.
No stable Korean machine feed for freebies was found; the machine layer is the NIPA listing watch, checked 2026-11-14.
